identity.applied_to: project author metadata and maintainer documentation

implemented: Explicit refusal of unsupported OpenAI Responses wrapper calls
Atomic per-wrapper estimated cost reservation and conservative settlement across sync/async/streams/failure/cancellation
Incomplete and invalid usage does not free reserved budget
System blocks, tool definitions and historical tool arguments included in supported text estimates
Approval v2 binds issuance timestamp, nonce, selected arguments and host-owned context
Durable atomic approval/quorum consumption, without consuming live grants during monitor replay
Evalcraft cassette bridge with cache normalization, stable IDs, observed result annotations and strict ambiguity rejection
Turn count retained during event and cassette replay
Synthetic refund ownership/approval/idempotency/uncertain-result/restart application and changed-code playback tests
Current google-genai migration and httpx/httpx2 playback coverage
Contributor onboarding, scoped contributor tasks, pilot scope and migration documentation

validation.review: All five reported probes plus duplicate result/ID and approval clock probes independently rechecked successfully
validation.runtime: Python 3.14; provider SDK calls mocked; no paid model calls or real payments

migration.approval_tokens: Pre-v2 envelopes are rejected; reissue host tokens. Durable consumption requires an HMAC secret and persistent store.
migration.gemini: Use google-genai Client.models / Client.aio.models; non-streaming capture only.

limits: Estimated budgets are scoped to one covered wrapper, not a universal provider billing cap.
Approval consumption is authorization use, not proof of human identity or exactly-once external effects.
Refund application uses synthetic provider/storage and must be adapted to customer-owned endpoints.
Revenue/pricing and contributor growth remain validation hypotheses.
Existing research and reproduction script describe the baseline checkout; fixed vulnerabilities need current regression tests rather than expecting old probes to succeed.
unchanged: existing recorded cassettes and golden fixtures
devops_handoff: A user-designated DEVOPS agent must handle any approved version/release/distribution or deployment work.
next_customer_validation: Test one paid customer workflow before building a hosted platform or splitting a new framework repository.
